comparator.route: Ordinary PPS programme with six student-selected thematic modules
comparator.sourceNotes: The three prospective year overviews sum to 60+60+60=180 EC. Year one has twelve 5-EC compulsory philosophy and skills courses. Year two has a 10-EC compulsory project and 5-EC Power of Words plus three student-chosen 15-EC PPS modules; year three has 5-EC Philosophy in Practice and 10-EC thesis plus three such modules. Each module comprises three 5-EC courses and themes are selected by students; one or two module substitutions from other faculty courses may be possible. The alternative semester-one/semester-two thesis listing is counted once. The zero-credit RADAr assessment is excluded. Prospectus pages describe concurrent years and do not guarantee one entrant-cohort schedule.

alternatives.concept: A broad UCR philosophy and politics route integrates philosophical history, ethics, selfhood, political theory, international institutions, rhetoric, society and critical examination of new technologies and environmental justice. Radboud teaches a sustained philosophy-first curriculum and six dedicated PPS thematic modules; UCR distributes this study across separate disciplines.

notes.text: UCR combines philosophy, political theory, sociology, law, communication, media and environmental courses. Radboud has a philosophy-first 60-EC introductory year followed by six dedicated, student-selected philosophical modules and its own thesis. The UCR choices are related academic paths, not course equivalencies or credit-transfer advice.
